text:
glasses_omar: Pattern is highly variable, not fixed to living room. Missed bed_b1 at 21:27 after assuming coffee_table_l1. Check bed_b1, coffee_table_l1, and bathroom_shelf_ba1. Do not assume it stays in the living room during the evening.

book_omar: New pattern identified. Missed bed_b1 at 21:31 and coffee_table_l1 at 13:02. It moves between the living room (coffee_table_l1) and bedroom (bed_b1). Check both locations; do not assume it stays on the couch or in one room.

mug_omar: Consistently at coffee_table_l1 during the day and evening (missed at 19:02). Previous assumption of sink_k1 or kitchen_table_k1 is incorrect for these times. Check coffee_table_l1 first, then kitchen_table_k1.

water_bottle_omar: Highly inconsistent. Missed coffee_table_l1 at 11:41 and kitchen_table_k1 at 20:32. It swaps between living and kitchen tables. Check coffee_table_l1 and kitchen_table_k1. Avoid cupboard_k1 and pantry_shelf_k1.

glass_omar: Missed kitchen_table_k1 at 20:31 after assuming sink_k1. It is not always at the sink. Check kitchen_table_k1 and sink_k1.

charger_omar: No new misses today. Keep previous note: Check coffee_table_l1, entry_floor_e1, and entry_hook_e1.

razor_omar: No new misses today. Keep previous note: Check bathroom_shelf_ba1 and sink_ba_ba1.

General: Items frequently move between coffee_table_l1 and kitchen_table_k1, or between living room and bedroom (bed_b1). Avoid assuming items stay in the kitchen sink or on the couch. Always check the specific table or bed surface rather than general room locations.
